Julian insisted they immediately leave the city and lay low at his secluded mountain cabin.

They took his custom-built sports car, navigating the winding, treacherous roads of upstate New York.

The sky turned a menacing shade of gray as a heavy rainstorm battered the windshield.

As they approached a steep downward curve, Julian pressed his foot onto the brake pedal.

The pedal sank completely to the floorboard with zero resistance.

Panic surged through the cabin as Julian pumped the brakes again, but the car only accelerated.

"Hold on to me!" Julian shouted over the roaring engine, gripping the steering wheel until his knuckles turned white.

Mara braced herself against the dashboard, her heart pounding furiously against her ribs.

They were hurtling toward a massive concrete barrier at over ninety miles per hour.

Julian expertly downshifted the gears, deliberately grinding the transmission to slow their momentum.

With a final, desperate maneuver, he swiped the side of the car against the steel guardrail.

Sparks flew into the rainy night as the friction violently ripped the doors and paint apart.

The car finally screeched to a smoking, terrifying halt just inches from the cliff's edge.

Julian unbuckled his seatbelt and pulled Mara into a crushing, desperate embrace.

Someone had cut the brake lines, turning his luxury car into a three-ton weapon.
